dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: ...Hmm, seems you've already learned all the secrets and found the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You... you're really going to clean it all up?

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: Yep. That's the job the helmsman arranged for me, so I can't refuse.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: That's just how things go at The Rusty Rudder, because... we're all under the helmsman's protection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Protection? Isn't this place a tavern?

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: The title of "helmsman" isn't exactly hyperbole. It's more of an... objective adjective.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: Mr. Pitot was in charge once... and changed many people's lives.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: For those who volunteered to dive into the depths of the ocean, Mr. Pitot was the only helmsman they could rely on.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: Until one day, when Mr. Pitot relaxed his grip on the tiller and left the deep sea... He was also one of the few people who could get out of there unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: ...I've told you everything I can. That's it.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: Have a nice day at The Rusty Rudder.
